About the Practice

Westchester Medical Center Health Network (WMCHealth) is one of New York's top healthcare systems, providing expert and comprehensive care across the Hudson Valley. [3] It is a 1,700-bed healthcare system headquartered in Valhalla, New York, with nine hospitals on seven campuses. [3, 9, 11] WMCHealth offers a wide range of specialties including cardiology, neurology, women's health, pediatrics, trauma care, oncology, orthopedics, and more. [3, 4, 5] As the region's only academic medical center and a pre-eminent provider of integrated health care in the Hudson Valley, WMCHealth offers both primary and highly specialized care, access to clinical trials, and advanced treatments. [3, 5, 11] The network includes Level I adult and pediatric trauma centers, a dedicated burn center, the region's only advanced care children's hospital, and one of the largest mental health systems in New York State. [11]

Electronic Health Record System

Oracle (Cerner)

Primary Electronic Health Record System

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

Westchester Medical Center (WMCHealth) utilizes a patient portal known as "myCare". This portal provides patients with secure online access to their personal health information, including medical history, medication lists, test results, and the ability to communicate with participating WMCHealth providers. WMCHealth entered into a strategic alliance with Cerner in 2019 to implement Cerner's integrated electronic health record (EHR) system across its network, including Westchester Medical Center. Although the search results do not explicitly state that the "myCare" portal is a Cerner product, the implementation of Cerner's EHR system following this alliance, and "myCare" functioning as the patient portal for WMCHealth accessing these records, indicates that "myCare" is the patient portal tied to the Cerner EHR system at Westchester Medical Center.
